name: Book Buddy
label: Full-stack library platform
description: A library platform that connects a React interface to book, loan, authentication, and notification APIs.
highlights: Connected catalog search, borrowing, returns, and account screens to REST endpoints.
Implemented JWT authentication and user, manager, and admin access rules.
Used database transactions to update loan records, book availability, and notifications together.
note: Academic project. Source code is public; a hosted demo is not provided.

name: Librarium
label: Python web application
description: A library application covering the journey from finding a book to borrowing it and returning it.
highlights: Built member and admin workflows with hashed-password authentication and route guards.
Implemented catalog search, filtering, loan history, due dates, and overdue-loan views.
Packaged the app with Docker Compose and documented the data model and system flows.
note: Academic project with local demo setup documented in the repository.

name: HealthGuard
label: Browser extension + Python API
description: A Chrome extension prototype that sends selected webpage claims to a Python analysis API.
highlights: Built the selection-to-popup flow using Chrome content scripts and a background service worker.
Integrated optional Hugging Face zero-shot classification with a local rule-based fallback.
Handled empty selection, loading, results, and server errors in the React popup.
note: Educational prototype. Analysis uses an optional inference service or a mock fallback; it is not clinically validated. Source repository is private.

name: Daemon
label: Interactive workspace demo
description: A marketing workspace demo for project conversations, campaign planning, and creative previews.
highlights: Created an interactive frontend workspace with project conversations and a shared campaign plan.
Added campaign-map and creative-preview views.
Kept workspace state in the browser for a self-contained demonstration.
note: Frontend demo. Agent responses, account flows, approvals, and publishing are simulated.

name: Rental Countdown
label: Mobile-first browser tool
description: A rental timer interface with active sessions, completion confirmation, and locally saved state.
highlights: Built a mobile-first rental flow with persistent countdown timers.
Added completion confirmation, sound and vibration alerts where supported.
Supported adding games with uploaded photos and resetting completed rentals for the day.
note: Static browser application. Data is saved on the current device.

name: Flight Delay Explorer
label: Data application
description: A dashboard for exploring historical flight predictions, risk scores, and feature explanations.
highlights: Organized views for model comparison, historical predictions, and high-risk flights.
Added a flight simulator that uses a saved model pipeline.
Presented feature importance and SHAP explanations with cached local artifacts.
note: Educational model and dashboard. No production impact or predictive accuracy is claimed here.

name: Viva Hurghada
label: Travel landing page
description: A travel website presenting Hurghada tours and excursions, with booking inquiries handled through WhatsApp.
highlights: Built a responsive interface for browsing tours and excursion information.
Connected booking inquiries to WhatsApp.
Added site icons and browser metadata.
note: Public travel website. Booking inquiries are sent through WhatsApp; the site does not process online payments.

name: Edumad
label: HTML and CSS practice
description: An educational-platform landing page exercise with static content sections and visual sign-in controls.
highlights: Created static sections for community features, courses, and team content.
Practiced page layout and styling with local images and icon fonts.
note: Early frontend practice project. Navigation placeholders and sign-in controls are visual only; this demo has no account system.
